title: Quietly Savory Greek Lamb Stew
description: A savory and romantic Greek dish featuring tender lamb, crispy bacon, and tangy nuka-pickle, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly dinner.
instructions: Heat the hot pot vessel over medium heat and cook the diced bacon until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the vessel and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the chopped onion to the vessel and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the vessel and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb cubes to the vessel and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped nuka-pickle, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to the vessel and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth to the vessel and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the cooked bacon and serve hot.
Serve the stew in bowls and enjoy.
Garnish with fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
